stops.title: Where James led the church
stops.text: Jerusalem is not named in the letter. It is shown because James, brother of Jesus, led the church there (if he is the writer).

real.label: Map of the land of Israel, drawn from real coordinates. The numbered stop marks Jerusalem.
real.regionLegend: Regions: darker shading where more sources agree on their extent
